title: 公司聚会怎么安排：固定活动与灵活时间
topic: 公司聚会怎么安排：固定活动与灵活时间

source.title: Our Rituals — Meet-ups
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课展示 37signals 员工手册 Chapter 5 的完整 Meet-ups 小节。练习重点为提前排定的少数活动、其他时间的灵活安排，以及团队如何使用开放时段。聚会通常每年两次、为期一周；练习中的具体产品复盘为虚构场景。
paragraphs: The entire company gathers in person twice a year. We meet up in a different city every time. In 2022, we traveled to Miami and Amsterdam. In 2023, Barcelona and New Orleans. Most of the planning is taken care of for you; you just need to book your flights. Lodging, meeting space, agenda, and social outings will be planned and communicated well in advance.

There are some scheduled talks at every meet-up, like the All Hands session on Monday morning, lightning talks, and peer appreciation. Occasionally, we bring in outside speakers or trainers. Other than that, the meet-up is intentionally loosely structured. Teams huddle in a breakout room for a strategy session, groups go out for coffee or to explore the city, or managers meet 1:1s with employees.

Meet-ups are 1 week long. Most people arrive Sunday, we meet Monday through Thursday, then travel home on Friday. Everyone should come to every meet-up, but skipping one here and there is okay if you have an engagement you can’t cancel.
translations: 全公司每年会线下聚会两次，每次选择不同城市。2022 年去了迈阿密和阿姆斯特丹，2023 年去了巴塞罗那和新奥尔良。大部分行程会替你安排好；你只需要订机票。住宿、会议场地、议程和社交活动都会提前规划并通知。
每次聚会都会安排一些固定演讲，例如周一上午的全员会议、闪电演讲和同事互相致谢。有时还会请外部演讲者或培训师。除此之外，聚会会有意保持宽松灵活。团队可以在分组会议室讨论策略，小组可以去喝咖啡或逛城市，经理也可以和员工进行一对一交流。
每次聚会持续一周。大多数人周日抵达，周一至周四参加活动，周五返程。所有人都应参加每次聚会；如果有无法取消的安排，偶尔缺席一次也可以。

notes.explain: 说明 37signals 全员聚会的频率和线下形式。
notes.example: The entire company gathers in person twice a year.

notes.explain: 手册将它列为聚会中的固定演讲环节，没有规定每场时长。
notes.example: Lightning talks are one of the scheduled talks at the meet-up.

notes.explain: 固定安排之外的多数时间可留给团队讨论、喝咖啡或一对一交流。
notes.example: The rest of the meet-up is intentionally loosely structured.

notes.phrase: skipping one here and there is okay
notes.explain: 这是在有无法取消的安排时偶尔缺席；手册仍说每个人都应参加每次聚会。
notes.example: Skipping one meet-up here and there is okay if you have an engagement you can’t cancel.

scenario.title: Explaining the company meet-up schedule
english: A new teammate asks how the company meet-up and its working sessions are usually organized.
The meet-up happens twice a year and lasts a week. A few sessions are scheduled, while most of the time is intentionally flexible.
You explain which activities are fixed and suggest coordinating with the other team for the open time.
chinese: 新同事问，公司聚会及其中的工作环节通常如何安排。
公司每年举办两次为期一周的聚会。少数活动会提前安排，大部分时间则有意保持灵活。
你说明哪些活动是固定的，并建议与另一个团队协调开放时段。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新同事想提前安排 team meet-up 期间的协作时间。请用英文说明少数固定活动会提前安排，大部分时间留给团队自行交流和开一对一会议。
firstAttempt.sample: A few sessions, including Monday’s All Hands, are scheduled in advance. Most of the week remains flexible for teams to meet, work together, or have one-to-ones.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说明提前安排的固定环节，再解释团队可以灵活使用其他时间。

words.example: The whole company gathers in person twice a year for a meet-up.
words.translation: 全体员工每年会线下聚会两次。
words.note: 强调面对面交流而非远程参与，适用于团队建设活动

words.example: Teams huddle in a breakout room for a strategy session.
words.translation: 各团队会在分组会议室里进行策略讨论。
words.note: 这里指线下聚会期间供小组讨论使用的会议室。

words.example: Peer appreciation is one of the scheduled talks at every meet-up.
words.translation: 同事互相致谢是每次聚会中的固定分享环节之一。
words.note: 手册把 peer appreciation 列为每次聚会安排的演讲活动之一。

words.example: The rest of the meet-up is intentionally loosely structured.
words.translation: 聚会的其他时间会有意安排得比较灵活。
words.note: 形容活动或计划有灵活性，不严格遵循固定流程

words.example: Teams huddle in a breakout room for a strategy session.
words.translation: 各团队会在分组会议室里进行策略讨论。
words.note: 指团队在聚会期间安排的策略讨论。

words.example: Managers meet one-to-ones with employees during the meet-up.
words.translation: 经理会在聚会期间与员工进行一对一交流。
words.note: 表示两个人单独沟通；来源使用复数 one-to-ones。

structure.original: There are some scheduled talks at every meet-up, like the All Hands session on Monday morning, lightning talks, and peer appreciation.
analysis: There are some scheduled talks 是 there be 句型，说明每次聚会都有一些固定演讲。
at every meet-up 表示这些固定环节每次聚会都会安排。
like 后列出例子：周一上午的 All Hands、闪电演讲和同事互相致谢。
structure.transfer: Monday’s All Hands is scheduled, but teams can use the open blocks later in the week for strategy sessions or one-to-ones.

rewrite.bad: Let’s schedule every hour of the company meet-up so there is no unstructured time.
rewrite.good: Each company meet-up has a few scheduled sessions, such as Monday’s All Hands, but most of the week is intentionally flexible for team discussions and one-to-ones.
rewrite.translation: 公司聚会会安排少数固定环节，例如周一的全员会议；大部分时间则有意留给团队讨论和一对一交流。
rewrite.pattern: A few sessions are [scheduled in advance], while most of the time stays [flexible for teams].

cloze.prompt: A few sessions are ___ in advance.
cloze.why: scheduled in advance 表示这些固定环节会提前安排。
flexible 表示这段时间没有全部预先排满，可由团队安排。
one-to-ones 指一对一交流；此处用复数和主语 managers 对应。

dictation.text: The entire company gathers in person twice a year.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 聚会频率
dictation.why: 听清 gathers in person twice a year，辨认线下聚会频次。

dictation.text: Other than that, the meet-up is intentionally loosely structured.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 开放时间
dictation.why: 听出 intentionally loosely structured，理解固定环节以外的安排。

apply.prompt: 同事担心聚会周已经排满。请说明少数活动固定，大部分时间灵活，并建议一起找合适时段。
apply.sample: A few sessions are scheduled in advance, but most of the week is flexible. Let’s find an open time that works for both teams.

translationPractice.prompt: 包括周一 All Hands 在内，有少数环节会提前安排。
translationPractice.answer: A few sessions, including Monday’s All Hands, are scheduled in advance.
translationPractice.why: a few sessions 表示只有少数环节；scheduled in advance 表示提前排定。

translationPractice.prompt: 一周中的大部分时间较灵活，团队可以自行安排会议、协作或一对一沟通。
translationPractice.answer: Most of the week remains flexible for teams to meet, work together, or have one-to-ones.
translationPractice.why: remain flexible 描述开放时段；for 后列出团队可以安排的活动。

translationPractice.prompt: 团队可以根据项目需要安排一周中的其他时间。
translationPractice.answer: Teams can arrange the rest of the week around their project needs.
translationPractice.why: arrange ... around ... 表示根据项目需要协调剩余时间。

choice.prompt: 新同事问公司聚会和 All Hands 通常怎么安排。请用英文说明哪些环节固定、哪些时间留给团队自行交流。
options: Monday’s All Hands is scheduled, and every remaining team session is also fixed before the meet-up.
Each company meet-up has a few scheduled sessions, such as Monday’s All Hands, but most of the week is intentionally flexible for team discussions and one-to-ones.
Every hour of the company meet-up follows a fixed mandatory schedule.
choice.why: 正确项既说明少数固定活动，也说明其余时间有意留白，符合手册对聚会安排的描述。

output.prompt: 跨部门同事想在公司聚会周安排一次产品复盘，担心日程已经排满。请用英文说明只有少数全员活动会提前排定，其余时间通常留给团队灵活安排，并邀请对方商量时间。
output.sample: Monday’s All Hands is one of the sessions scheduled in advance. The rest of the week is more flexible, so let’s find a time that works for both teams.
check: 是否说明少数固定环节会提前安排？
是否说明其余时间较灵活？
是否提出结合团队日程商量具体时间？
